findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 19 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 66 questions numbered 1-66; by section: 19.1 15, 19.2 12, 19.3 9, 19.4 7, 19.5 13, 19.6 6, 19.7A 4.

Covers the introduction and sections 19.1-19.7A in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (1 u = 1/12 of carbon-12, potential zero at infinity, iron-56, deuterium-tritium fuels, A = λN, slow-neutron absorption by control rods, technetium-99m, LHC proton-proton collisions).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
